entries.name: A Hidden Cave
entries.text: You do not land where you fell. A draught of cold air, moss underfoot: a cave no map shows, and an old chest under a fall of roots.

entries.name: A Remnant Soul in a Ring
entries.text: A cracked bronze ring in the grass. A thin old voice speaks from it: "Carry me a while." It recites a page of its art before it fades.

entries.name: The Hermit's Chess Problem
entries.text: An old man at a stone board does not look up. "White lives in three." You stand there until you see it, and something else comes clear with it.

entries.name: A Wounded Crane
entries.text: A Jade Crane beats one wing in the reeds, an arrow through the other. Your own crane keeps watch while you draw the shaft and bind the wing.

entries.name: A Jar of Hundred-Year Wine
entries.text: Your hand finds a sealed jar under the roots. The clay is black with age; the wine inside smells of a hundred autumns.

entries.name: A Lost Child
entries.text: A child sits by the path, too frightened to cry. You walk them home, and a mother runs out to meet you.

entries.name: A Meteor Fragment
entries.text: A streak of light, a thump in the next field. The stone is still warm: Cloudsteel, fallen from somewhere far above the ledges.

entries.name: A Dream of the River
entries.text: You doze for a moment and dream of the River: every land on its banks, every one who ever drank from it. You wake knowing something you did not learn.
